contradictions.resolving_limits_sentence: Code a change moves from one file to another as its base version had it counts as a line the change does not otherwise touch: it keeps its layout in the move, style violations included, and a layout fix to it goes in a separate change.

contradictions.sentence_a: every added or changed line is committed as that formatter prints it under the project's settings
contradictions.sentence_b: Count any difference inside the moved block as an edit: whitespace or layout ...
contradictions.resolving_limits_sentence: Where the project's format check enforces a formatter on the destination file, the layout that formatter prints for the moved lines belongs to the move, since restoring the old layout fails the check; every other edit to the moved lines still goes in a separate change.

contradictions.sentence_a: A private field that every routine using it assigns before it first reads it becomes a local variable of those routines.
contradictions.sentence_b: A field of a type whose values are compared, hashed, printed or serialized as a whole ... is outside the rule ... A field that other code may assign while a method sits between its own assignment and a later read ... is outside the rule.
contradictions.resolving_limits_sentence: A private field that generated or built-in equality, hashing, formatting or serialization reads, that a closure or nested type captures, or that another method, a callback or concurrently running code may assign between a routine's assignment and its read carries a value beyond one call and stays a field.

A pinning net is shown to fail when the code at the change point is altered
